name: all-mpnet-base-v2
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: Encoder: kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. MPNet architecture (not BERT): hidden 768, 12 layers, 12 heads, intermediate 3072, vocab 30527, max_position_embeddings 514. Uses relative position bias (32 buckets) instead of absolute position embeddings. Same parameter count as bge-base and gte-base (109M) but different architecture. Apache-2.0. GGUF and ONNX ports exist. The sentence-transformers library default for higher quality.
